articles.title: Balance stablecoin collapses 99% after $1 million exploit drains its bitcoin vaults
articles.snippet: An attacker fed the lending system a fake, abnormally low bitcoin price, liquidated vaults that should have been safe, and pocketed the difference in a single transaction.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $66,000 as stocks claw back from big early decline
articles.snippet: Later on Wednesday, Alphabet's earnings should give a sign of whether the hundreds of billions going into AI is paying off.

articles.title: Crypto lobby group Digital Chamber sues Illinois to block digital asset tax
articles.snippet: Illinois enacted a 0.2% tax on all crypto transactions last month, with the tax taking effect next year.

articles.title: Russia’s parliament passes crypto market law with $3,800 annual cap for retail investors
articles.snippet: While citizens still cannot use Bitcoin to buy groceries, the Kremlin is officially letting companies use digital tokens to bypass sanctions and other global trade hurdles.

articles.title: US officials barred until 2029 from issuing or sponsoring tokens under CLARITY’s proposed ethics rules
articles.snippet: According to Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the bill’s advocates, the ethics language would apply to US presidents’ crypto ventures, including Donald Trump’s.
